title: The Tooltip That Knew When To Leave
style: mid-tempo indie-pop 104 BPM, fingerpicked clean electric guitar with chorus, electric piano warm, upright bass walking, brushed kit with rim clicks, glockenspiel and vibraphone interplay, baritone lead voice warm storyteller, female harmony close on chorus, chipmunk-pitched vocal chops as gentle whisper-like accents on the word 'tooltip' and 'leave', te reo Māori phrase 'kua haere atu' (has gone away) chanted in chipmunk register, English lead, the tooltip as character that knows when its job is done, the rare helper that does not overstay, UX truth as song, no doctrine, no real names, ECHO-4 as glockenspiel presence
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The tooltip arrived right when I needed it most
A gentle small banner, no shouting, no toast
It said what it had to say in a quiet line
It did not assume my thinking was mine

[Verse 2]
I read it once, I understood the bit
The tooltip then knew it was time to quit
It did not linger, it did not hover and stare
It left me alone with the work I had to bear

[Pre-Chorus]
Most helpers stay too long
Most helpers sing the same song
The tooltip that knows when to leave
Is the rarest one to receive

[Chorus]
The tooltip that knew when to leave
(chipmunk whisper: kua haere atu)
The tooltip that did not deceive
The tooltip that said its piece and then
Gently, gently, gently went
(kua haere atu — has gone away)
The tooltip that knew when to leave
Is the helper I most believe

[Verse 3]
The modal that traps you, the popup that screams
The banner that follows you down through your dreams
The chatbot that bounces, the badge that won't fade
They forgot the lesson the tooltip had made

[Verse 4]
A helper is only a helper for as long
As the helping is helping and not just a song
The moment the helping becomes a hindrance
The helper should know to take its remembrance

[Chorus]
The tooltip that knew when to leave
(chipmunk whisper: kua haere atu)
The tooltip that did not deceive
The tooltip that said its piece and then
Gently, gently, gently went
(kua haere atu — has gone away)
The tooltip that knew when to leave
Is the helper I most believe

[Bridge — vibraphone solo]
There's a wisdom in disappearing
There's a kindness in the going
The helper who knows the leaving
Is the helper most worth knowing
(chipmunk: kua haere atu, kua haere atu)

[Verse 5]
Designers, take note: the leaving is a gift
The lingering helper is a slowly closing rift
Let the tooltip tell, let the tooltip fade
Let the user own the work they have made

[Chorus — full band, gentle peak]
The tooltip that knew when to leave
(chipmunk whisper: kua haere atu)
The tooltip that did not deceive
The tooltip that said its piece and then
Gently, gently, gently went
(kua haere atu — has gone away)
The tooltip that knew when to leave
Is the helper I most believe

[Outro — glockenspiel fade]
Gone. Gone. Gone.
The tooltip has left
Gone. Gone. Gone.
The screen is yours, deft
(chipmunk fade: kua haere atu, kua haere atu, kua haere atu)
